### Added

- **Pure black (AMOLED)** (Theme, dark only): main and chat backgrounds become #000; headers, menus and the composer stay slightly grey. Checked against WCAG AA in every theme.
- **Stickers in attachments menu** (Chat appearance, off by default): hides the composer sticker button and adds Stickers to the attachments menu. The reply you are writing is kept.
- **Collapsible chat list** on wide windows: the chevron above the Menu button or **Ctrl+B** (⌘B) slides the list out; while collapsed the button shows the unread count. Narrow and portrait layouts are unchanged.
- **Open documents in the default app** (#279, part one): tapping a pdf, docx, txt or other file opens it in the system app — desktop and Android through a decrypted temporary copy with the original name; on Android, "No app can open this file" offers **Save as…**. The PWA opens pdf/text in a new tab and downloads the rest. Images, video, audio, webxdc and HTML keep their in-app viewers. "Show in folder" is still to come.

### Fixed

- Desktop opened the encrypted attachment file (hash name) instead of the document when database encryption was on.
- Stickers and apps keep the active reply (#264). Quote and forward markers are matched case-sensitively, so a webxdc no longer counts as a reply (#263).
- Webxdc info lines show the sender as a profile chip (#265).
- @mention picker: shows a loading row, lists letters first in big chats, uses custom avatars and refreshes when members change (#266).
- Browser (PWA) core: attachments round-trip again and a timer trap is gone (#261).
- The empty chat pane's subtitle meets WCAG AA contrast.

### Removed

- The article card (#252) is not part of this release; it stays on its own branch.

### Security

- Android: profile data encryption as shipped in 1.4.89. Desktop and PWA: preview. Attachment encryption at rest: work in progress.
